answer: The 3-qubit GHZ circuit ran on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. Job 01a15f55-24f9-72a2-823b-eda1396fad09 completed. I first ran one free test job on sirius:mock (01a15f54-f966-709d-b7d8-1e87ffd8b2de). Real counts were 000: 46, 111: 39, 110: 5, 101: 4, 011: 2, 100: 2, 001: 1, 010: 1. That means 85 of 100 shots were 000 or 111, so the fraction is 0.85. The API does not return a credits field. GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} reports metrics.billed_seconds = 1.0, with execution_seconds 0.194 and runtime_seconds 0.399. I multiplied the 1.0 billed second by the sirius rate of 0.3 credits per second to get 0.30 credits. That rate comes from the repo docs, and an earlier 100-shot sirius job billed 0.30 credits at the same rate. The Resonance dashboard is the authoritative source for the exact credit charge.
